newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Bemis raised by Merrill.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Bemis raised by Merrill.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch said it raised its recommendation on Bemis Co Inc to near-term buy from neutral and to long-term buy from accumulate, and named Bemis Merrill's Focus One stock.
-- Shares rose 1-3/4 to 39, a new year-high, in early Wednesday NYSE trade.

-- Merrill anaylst Doug Groh said that according to a recently completed Merrill study of the packaging container and plastic packaging sectors, he found "the plastic film and sheet business should enjoy six percent growth per year and we expect Bemis' top line to grow about 10 percent. Given their ability to leverage plastic resin prices, which we expect to decline as new capacity comes on, Bemis' margins should expand and the bottom line should grow about 15 percent."
-- Groh said he expects Bemis to earn $2.15 in 1997 and $2.45 in 1998. The company earned $1.63 in 1995.
-- The 12-month stock price target is about $46 to $47 per share, according to Groh.
